name: peanut
description: A local-first technical knowledge management system.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @peanut/contracts && concurrently -k -n contracts,server,web -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @peanut/contracts" "npm run dev -w @peanut/server" "npm run dev -w @peanut/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @peanut/contracts && npm run build -w @peanut/server && npm run build -w @peanut/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @peanut/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @peanut/server && npm run typecheck -w @peanut/web && npm run typecheck -w @peanut/cloud
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
